series.name: Association for Education Finance and Policy Annual Conference
series.organizer: Association for Education Finance and Policy (AEFP)
series.notes: Important dates at https://aefpweb.org/conference-dates. Submissions via Oxford Abstracts.

series.name: APPAM Fall Research Conference
series.organizer: Association for Public Policy Analysis & Management (APPAM)
series.associated_journal: Journal of Policy Analysis and Management
series.notes: Public policy conference (all policy areas). A separate Late-Breaking Roundtable call runs late August to late September.

series.name: International Workshop on Applied Economics of Education (IWAEE)
series.organizer: Magna Graecia University of Catanzaro, with Lancaster University and NTNU
series.notes: Held in Catanzaro (Calabria), Italy. 2026 fees: EUR 405, EUR 300 for PhD students.

series.name: EAERE Annual Conference
series.organizer: European Association of Environmental and Resource Economists (EAERE)
series.notes: Non-members of EAERE may submit papers. No EAERE conference in World Congress years (2026, 2030); the 2027 conference is in Madrid.

series.name: World Congress of Environmental and Resource Economists (WCERE)
series.organizer: World Council of Environmental and Resource Economists Associations (WCEREA), incl. EAERE, AERE and AAERE
series.site_note: Each congress has its own website (2026: wcere2026.org), announced on the EAERE, AERE and AAERE sites. Search "WCERE 2030".
series.notes: 7th WCERE: Nova SBE, Carcavelos (Lisbon area), 29 Jun-3 Jul 2026. EAERE and AERE skip their own conferences in congress years.

series.name: AERE Summer Conference
series.organizer: Association of Environmental and Resource Economists (AERE)
series.associated_journal: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists (JAERE)
series.notes: Abstract-based call; individual abstracts and complete session proposals. No 2026 conference because of WCERE 2026.

series.name: AERE Sessions at the ASSA Annual Meeting
series.organizer: Association of Environmental and Resource Economists (AERE)
series.notes: AERE-organized sessions inside the ASSA/AEA Annual Meeting; separate call from the AEA general call. Abstracts of max. 300 words, up to two per presenting author.

series.name: AERE Sessions at the Eastern Economic Association Annual Conference (AERE@EEA)
series.organizer: Association of Environmental and Resource Economists (AERE)
series.notes: Separate AERE call for sessions within the EEA meeting. Presenters must be AERE members for the conference year; no EEA submission fee for AERE@EEA papers.

series.name: AERE Sessions at the WEAI Annual Conference (AERE@WEAI)
series.organizer: Association of Environmental and Resource Economists (AERE)
series.notes: Separate AERE call for sessions within the WEAI meeting. Presenters must be AERE members for the conference year.

series.name: AERE Sessions at the Midwest Economics Association Meeting
series.organizer: Association of Environmental and Resource Economists (AERE)
series.notes: Separate AERE call for sessions within the MEA meeting.

series.name: AERE Sessions at the Southern Economic Association Meeting
series.organizer: Association of Environmental and Resource Economists (AERE)
series.notes: Separate AERE call for sessions within the SEA meeting (earlier than the SEA general deadline).

series.name: CREEA|ACERE Annual Conference (Canadian Resource and Environmental Economics)
series.organizer: Canadian Resource and Environmental Economics Association (CREEA|ACERE)
series.notes: Two streams: complete papers (longer slot with discussant) and extended abstracts (10-15 min talks). Hosted by a different Canadian university each year (2026: University of Waterloo).

series.name: AAERE Annual Congress (Asian Association of Environmental and Resource Economics; formerly EAAERE)
series.organizer: Asian Association of Environmental and Resource Economics (AAERE)
series.notes: Successor of the East Asian Association of Environmental and Resource Economics (EAAERE; 8th Congress 2019); congress numbering continued under the AAERE name from 2021. Venue rotates across Asia; in scope only when held in Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, Hong Kong or Singapore (2024 Hsinchu was in scope; 2025 Beijing and 2026 Jakarta were not).

series.name: AARES Annual Conference (Australasian Agricultural & Resource Economics Society)
series.organizer: Australasian Agricultural and Resource Economics Society (AARES)
series.associated_journal: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics (AJARE)
series.notes: Agricultural & resource economics society; included for its resource and environmental economics component. Each conference has its own site linked from aares.org.au (2027: aares2027.com); abstracts via Oxford Abstracts.

series.name: IAEE International Conference
series.organizer: International Association for Energy Economics (IAEE)
series.notes: Venue rotates worldwide; only editions in the dashboard regions are in scope. 2026 (47th, Santiago, Chile) and 2027 (48th, Nanjing, China, 15-18 Aug 2027) are out of scope.

series.name: IAEE European Conference
series.organizer: International Association for Energy Economics (IAEE) with a national affiliate
series.notes: Organized with a national IAEE affiliate each year (2026 Munich; 2027 Madrid with AEEE).

series.name: USAEE/IAEE North American Conference
series.organizer: United States Association for Energy Economics (USAEE), affiliate of IAEE
series.notes: Individual works may be a full paper or an abstract only; full sessions also accepted. At least one author of an accepted presentation must register and attend in person.

series.name: IAEE Asia-Oceania Conference
series.organizer: International Association for Energy Economics (IAEE)
series.notes: Venue rotates in Asia-Oceania; in scope only when held in Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Singapore, Australia or New Zealand (e.g. 2020 Auckland). The 2026 (8th) edition was in Qingdao, China (out of scope).

series.name: IAEE Sessions at the ASSA Annual Meeting
series.organizer: International Association for Energy Economics (IAEE) / USAEE
series.notes: IAEE-sponsored energy and environmental economics sessions inside the ASSA Annual Meeting; submissions via Oxford Abstracts; in-person only; at least one author of an accepted paper must be an IAEE member.

series.name: Mannheim Conference on Energy and the Environment (MCEE)
series.organizer: ZEW - Leibniz Centre for European Economic Research
series.notes: Submissions via pretalx; full papers preferred (extended abstracts of 1,000+ words accepted); one accepted paper per submitting author; presenters also discuss a paper.

series.name: Toulouse Conference on the Economics of Energy and Climate
series.organizer: Toulouse School of Economics (TSE) Energy and Climate Center
series.notes: Also listed on CEPR events. Contact: elecconf@tse-fr.eu.

series.name: Heartland Environmental and Resource Economics Workshop
series.organizer: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign (Environmental and Resource Economics Workshop at Illinois)
series.notes: Aims at networking for graduate students and early-career faculty (8-minute talks and posters) but is not student-only; registration capped at 80. The site removes the deadline once submissions close.

series.name: Annual BIOECON Conference
series.organizer: BIOECON network (2026 hosted by University of Cambridge, Department of Land Economy)
series.notes: Complete papers only; special-session proposals (3-4 papers) by email to bioecon@bioecon-network.org. In-person only. 2026 presenter package GBP 320 incl. 2 nights at St John's College, Cambridge.

series.name: FAERE Annual Conference
series.organizer: French Association of Environmental and Resource Economists (FAERE)
series.notes: Full papers via sciencesconf.org; several submissions allowed but one presentation per person. Host university changes each year.

series.name: Monte Verità Conference on Sustainable Resource Use and Economic Dynamics (SURED)
series.organizer: University of Basel (founded at ETH Zurich)
series.notes: Held every two years at Monte Verità, Ascona (Switzerland); EAERE-supported.

series.name: Ulvön Conference on Environmental Economics
series.organizer: Centre for Environmental and Resource Economics (CERE), Umeå University and SLU
series.notes: Abstract submission via online form; strong PhD-student participation alongside senior researchers. 2025 fee EUR 500 (EUR 300 presenting PhD students) incl. food, lodging and transport from Umeå.

series.name: CESifo Area Conference on Energy and Climate Economics
series.organizer: CESifo (CESifo Network / ifo Institute)
series.notes: Primarily for CESifo network members; the 2023 call stated that submissions from non-network members would also be considered (check each call). Travel and accommodation of one speaker per accepted paper reimbursed (2026). A Junior Workshop on Energy and Climate Economics runs alongside.

series.name: Nordic Annual Environmental and Resource Economics Workshop (NAERE)
series.organizer: Nordic host institution (2026: Stockholm Institute of Transition Economics, SITE, at the Stockholm School of Economics)
series.site_note: No permanent website found; each edition is posted by its host (2026: SITE at the Stockholm School of Economics) and listed among EAERE supported events. Search "NAERE 2027" or "Nordic Annual Environmental and Resource Economics Workshop".
series.notes: Free participation in 2026. Extended abstracts (2-3 pages) welcome; completed papers may be preferred.

series.name: Annual Meeting of the Portuguese Economic Journal
series.organizer: Portuguese Economic Journal (PEJ), with the hosting Portuguese university
series.site_note: Each edition has its own host-university site, linked from the PEJ 'Upcoming Meeting' button (2026: https://www.ua.pt/pt/pej2026/). Past editions listed at https://pej.iseg.ulisboa.pt/past.html. The PEJ site has an incomplete TLS chain (WebFetch may fail; curl -k works).
series.notes: International generalist conference, first held 2007. Papers in English via Conference Maker; 600-word abstract on cover page.

series.name: Warsaw International Economic Meeting (WIEM)
series.organizer: Faculty of Economic Sciences, University of Warsaw
series.notes: All areas of economics (focus on macro, trade, labour, education, micro, IO, finance, econometrics). Young economists encouraged but not restricted. 2026 fee EUR 200 / PLN 850.

series.name: Western Regional Science Association (WRSA) Annual Meeting
series.organizer: Western Regional Science Association (WRSA)
series.site_note: Site redirects to https://www.wrsaonline.org/newsite/. Calls are also posted on the RSAI events calendar (regionalscience.org).
series.notes: Full papers only (drafts accepted); presenters also discuss/chair. Registration includes WRSA membership. Tiebout Prize competition has its own deadline.

series.name: Annual Conference on Urban and Regional Economics (CURE)
series.organizer: Centre for Economic Policy Research (CEPR), International Trade and Regional Economics Programme, with local organisers
series.frequency: Annual (Europe in odd years, USA in even years)
series.site_note: CEPR pages block WebFetch/curl (HTTP 403); read them with a browser. Submissions via CEPR HUB.
series.notes: Only European (odd-year) editions run through CEPR with an open call; US editions (e.g. Philadelphia) have been invitation-only. 2025: LSE, 7-8 Nov.

series.name: ABFER Annual Conference (Labour Economics; Real Estate and Urban Economics; Tech, Digital Markets and AI programs)
series.organizer: Asian Bureau of Finance and Economic Research (ABFER)
series.site_note: Call for papers posted on the annual-conference page (2026 call: https://www.abfer.org/events/abfer-events/annual-conference/417:accfp2026).
series.notes: Multi-program conference, mostly finance; only the Labour Economics, Real Estate and Urban Economics (joint with IREUS) and Tech, Digital Markets and AI programs are in scope. Fee waived for presenters and discussants; capped sponsorship for one author and one discussant per paper.

series.name: EEA-ESEM Congress (EEA Annual Congress and European Summer Meeting of the Econometric Society)
series.organizer: European Economic Association (EEA) and Econometric Society (ES)
series.site_note: Host city rotates. The EEA page links to the congress site https://www.eea-esem-congresses.org/ (reused each year); the Econometric Society event page for each edition posts submission dates first. EEA submissions go through congresscreator.org, ES submissions through Oxford Abstracts.
series.associated_journal: Journal of the European Economic Association; Econometrica
series.notes: Full papers only (no abstracts). One paper per author to each of the EEA and ES sessions; at least one co-author must be a member of the association submitted to. 2026 registration EUR 495 members / EUR 990 non-members. 2027: Prague, 23-27 Aug.

series.name: Royal Economic Society Annual Conference
series.organizer: Royal Economic Society (RES)
series.site_note: Each year has its own event page (e.g. https://res.org.uk/event-listing/res2027/), linked from the conference overview page.
series.typical_deadline: Mid/late January (General Sessions); April (Speed and Poster Sessions)
series.associated_journal: The Economic Journal; The Econometrics Journal
series.notes: Rotates across UK universities. No submission fee; RES membership not required to submit. Abstract plus (draft) paper required. 2027: University of Reading, 28-30 Jun.

series.name: Verein für Socialpolitik Annual Conference (VfS Jahrestagung)
series.organizer: Verein für Socialpolitik (German Economic Association, VfS)
series.site_note: Site shows a cookie wall; choose 'Technically necessary functions'. Each edition has an 'Annual Conference YYYY' page and an 'Open Meeting YYYY' call page.
series.notes: Open Meeting accepts papers and organised sessions from all fields of economics alongside a themed core conference. Held in German-speaking countries. 2027: Hannover, 26-29 Sep (core theme: Geoeconomics).

series.name: Simposio of the Spanish Economic Association (SAEe)
series.organizer: Spanish Economic Association (Asociación Española de Economía, SEA)
series.associated_journal: SERIEs - Journal of the Spanish Economic Association
series.notes: Papers in English via Congress Creator; one paper per participant. Host university in Spain rotates. 2026: Las Palmas de Gran Canaria, 16-18 Dec.

series.name: Annual Meeting of the Italian Economic Association (SIE RSA)
series.organizer: Società Italiana degli Economisti (Italian Economic Association, SIE)
series.site_note: Each edition's call is posted under the event's page on siecon.org (linked from the home page).
series.typical_deadline: End of April (individual papers); early/mid April (member-organised sessions)
series.notes: Call in English, open to members and non-members; full paper required. Registration includes SIE membership.

series.name: AFSE Annual Congress
series.organizer: Association Française de Science Économique (French Economic Association, AFSE)
series.site_note: Each edition has its own site (e.g. https://afse2026.sciencesconf.org/), linked from the 'Annual Congress' menu on afse.fr.
series.notes: Host city in France rotates. 2027: 75th congress, Strasbourg, 23-25 Jun.

series.name: Irish Economic Association Annual Conference
series.organizer: Irish Economic Association (IEA)
series.notes: Full papers (25-min slots), extended abstracts or early drafts (10-min flash talks) and organised sessions accepted (2026 rules). Location in Ireland rotates; 2026 organised by the Central Bank of Ireland in Thurles.

series.name: Scottish Economic Society Annual Conference
series.organizer: Scottish Economic Society (SES)
series.site_note: Each edition has its own Oxford Abstracts site (sesYY.oa-event.com, e.g. ses27 for 2027), linked from scotecon.org.
series.notes: Full manuscript preferred, extended abstract (750 words) accepted; one paper per presenting author; oral and poster formats from 2027. 2027: Heriot-Watt University, Edinburgh, 12-14 Apr.

series.name: Annual Meeting of the Austrian Economic Association (NOeG)
series.organizer: Nationalökonomische Gesellschaft (Austrian Economic Association, NOeG)
series.site_note: Calls are circulated on the noeg-l mailing list (mailman3.wu.ac.at) and on each edition's ConfTool site (e.g. conftool.com/noeg2026).
series.typical_deadline: Spring to early June (7 June in 2026)
series.notes: Host city in Austria rotates; 2026 was a joint SEA-NOeG conference with the Slovak Economic Association at CEU Vienna. 2027: Klagenfurt, 9-10 Sep.

series.name: SSES Annual Congress
series.organizer: Swiss Society of Economics and Statistics (SSES)
series.site_note: Old sgvs.ch URLs redirect to sses.swiss. Each edition has a page sses.swiss/conferences/ssesYYYY/; submissions via Converia.
series.associated_journal: Swiss Journal of Economics and Statistics
series.notes: Each congress has a special theme. Future hosts: 2027 UniDistance Suisse, Brig (17-18 Jun, 'AI and Economics'); 2028 University of Bern; 2029 University of Basel.

series.name: ASSET Annual Meeting
series.organizer: Association of Southern European Economic Theorists (ASSET)
series.site_note: Hosted by a different member institution each year on the host's own site (2026: https://crenoslef.wixsite.com/asset-2026; 2025: AIRESS, UM6P Rabat). Search 'ASSET 2027 annual meeting'.
series.notes: Open to researchers from member and non-member institutions. Some editions are held outside Europe (e.g. Morocco 2025) and are then out of scope.

series.name: European Winter Meeting of the Econometric Society (EWMES)
series.organizer: Econometric Society
series.notes: Open to all (best-paper award limited to authors within two years of PhD). One paper per presenter; at least one author must be an ES member. 2027: Université libre de Bruxelles, 16-18 Dec.

series.name: Korean Economic Review (KER) International Conference
series.organizer: Korean Economic Association (KEA)
series.notes: English-language international conference. Each edition also has its own Google Sites page (e.g. sites.google.com/view/ker2026). In 2026 presenters had to be KEA members.

series.name: Hong Kong Economic Association Biennial Conference
series.organizer: Hong Kong Economic Association (HKEA)
series.notes: 12th conference (15-16 Jun 2026) was held at the University of Macau, outside scope; check each edition's venue. cfp_page changes per edition.

series.name: Singapore Economic Review Conference (SERC)
series.organizer: Economic Growth Centre, Nanyang Technological University / The Singapore Economic Review
series.notes: Free submission via Editorial Express; selected papers invited to an SER special issue. Contact serc@ntu.edu.sg. The site still contains some template text and older 2024 wording.

series.name: East Asian Economic Association International Convention
series.organizer: East Asian Economic Association (EAEA)
series.frequency: Biennial historically; 2025 and 2026 held in consecutive years
series.site_note: No permanent EAEA website found. Each convention has its own site (e.g. eaea20.ateneo.edu, eaea21.pfm.gov.kh) and calls are also printed in the Asian Economic Journal. Search 'EAEA 22nd International Convention'.
series.notes: Venue rotates across East and Southeast Asia; only conventions in JP/KR/TW/HK/SG are in scope (2025 Manila and 2026 Siem Reap were out of scope).

series.name: Asian Meetings of the Econometric Society (AMES)
series.organizer: Econometric Society
series.frequency: Annual (several regional Asian meetings per year)
series.notes: Covers the East & Southeast Asia / Asia main meeting and any Asian meeting held in JP/KR/TW/HK/SG. 2027 Asia Main Meeting: Tokyo (Waseda), 3-5 Aug 2027. The 2027 Asia-China meeting (Wuhan) is out of scope; the 2026 China meeting was held in Hong Kong. ES membership required for submitting authors.

series.name: WEAI International Conference (formerly Pacific Rim Conference)
series.organizer: Western Economic Association International (WEAI)
series.notes: Asia-Pacific venues rotate; only editions in JP/KR/TW/HK/SG/AU/NZ are in scope. cfp_page changes per edition (look for 'Nth International Conference' on weai.org).

series.name: Australian Conference of Economists (ACE)
series.organizer: Economic Society of Australia (ESA)
series.notes: Hosting rotates among ESA state branches; each edition has its own site (e.g. ace2026.org.au). ACE 2027: Melbourne (RMIT), 6-9 Jul 2027. ACE 2026 fees: AUD 800 non-member early bird.

series.name: Australasia Meeting of the Econometric Society (ESAM)
series.organizer: Econometric Society
series.notes: Host university rotates within Australia/NZ (2026 Adelaide; 2027 Griffith University, Gold Coast, 1-3 Dec 2027). Submitters must be ES members.

series.name: AEA/ASSA Annual Meeting
series.organizer: American Economic Association (AEA) / Allied Social Science Associations (ASSA)
series.notes: Abstract-only submissions (max. 300 words); at least one author must be an AEA member. Future meetings: Atlanta Jan 7-9, 2028; San Diego Jan 5-7, 2029.

series.name: Econometric Society North American Summer Meeting
series.organizer: Econometric Society
series.site_note: Each edition is hosted by a university that may run its own meeting site; the Econometric Society's North America events page links to each edition.
series.notes: Since 2026 the Society's primary North American meeting (previously the Winter Meeting). Submitting author must be an Econometric Society member.

series.name: Econometric Society North American Winter Meeting (at ASSA)
series.organizer: Econometric Society
series.notes: Held as part of the ASSA meeting. At least one co-author must be an Econometric Society member; one paper per presenter. Continuation after the January 2027 edition not yet confirmed (NASM became the primary North American meeting in 2026).

series.name: Southern Economic Association Annual Meeting
series.organizer: Southern Economic Association (SEA)
series.notes: Abstract-only submission; USD 35 fee per individual paper (waived within complete session proposals).

series.name: Western Economic Association International Annual Conference
series.organizer: Western Economic Association International (WEAI)
series.notes: Abstract (350 words) submission requires paying submission + registration fee up front (registration refundable if rejected). WEAI's separate International (Pacific Rim) conference is not covered here.

series.name: Eastern Economic Association Annual Meetings
series.organizer: Eastern Economic Association (EEA)
series.typical_deadline: Early deadline Nov 1; regular deadline Dec 1
series.notes: Submissions via https://eea.meetingsavvy.net/. Often held in New York City, but the venue varies; check the region each year. CSWEP also runs sessions at this meeting.

series.name: Midwest Economics Association Annual Meetings
series.organizer: Midwest Economics Association (MEA)
series.notes: One-page abstract; MEA membership required to submit (membership + submission fee paid at submission).

series.name: International Atlantic Economic Conference (North America, fall)
series.organizer: International Atlantic Economic Society (IAES)
series.associated_journal: Atlantic Economic Journal; International Advances in Economic Research
series.notes: Possibly dormant: no conference held since the 96th IAEC (Philadelphia, Oct 2023); the site announces an unscheduled 2026 conference with abstract submission 'coming soon'. iaes.org returns HTTP 403 to simple fetchers (use a browser).

series.name: Canadian Economics Association Annual Conference
series.organizer: Canadian Economics Association (CEA)
series.site_note: Each edition has a page on economics.ca (e.g. https://www.economics.ca/cea-2027).
series.notes: Includes an online day about a week before the in-person meeting. 2027 hosted by Wilfrid Laurier University.

series.name: International Economic Association World Congress
series.organizer: International Economic Association (IEA)
series.site_note: Each congress has its own website (e.g. ieawc2026.org); find it via iea-world.org.
series.typical_call_posted: July of the year before the congress
series.typical_deadline: Mid-November of the year before the congress
series.notes: Rotates worldwide (2021 Indonesia, 2023 Colombia, 2026 Belgrade). Record editions only if the venue is in an in-scope region. 2029 host not yet chosen (letters of interest due 30 Nov 2026).

series.name: International Industrial Organization Conference (IIOC)
series.organizer: Industrial Organization Society (IOS)
series.notes: Submissions via Editorial Express; no submission fee. Past conferences listed at https://www.indorgsociety.org/history

series.name: EARIE Annual Conference
series.organizer: European Association for Research in Industrial Economics (EARIE)
series.typical_conference: last weekend of August / first weekend of September
series.notes: earie.org is behind a bot check and cannot be read automatically; check it manually. One paper per submitter (2025 rule).

series.name: CRESSE International Conference on Competition and Regulation
series.organizer: CRESSE (Competition and Regulation European Summer School and Conference)
series.associated_journal: International Journal of Industrial Organization (CRESSE special issue)
series.notes: Submissions by email (PDF) to info@cresse.info

series.name: Asia-Pacific Industrial Organization Conference (APIOC)
series.organizer: Asia-Pacific Industrial Organization Society (APIOS)
series.site_note: Each edition also has a host-university page (e.g. https://apios.org.au/apioc-2025/); calls are also posted on Econometric Society Australasia regional news
series.notes: Host rotates around the Asia-Pacific (2025 Brisbane; 2026 Xiamen, China, out of scope). Only editions in Australia/NZ or Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Singapore are in scope.

series.name: MaCCI Annual Conference
series.organizer: Mannheim Centre for Competition and Innovation (MaCCI): ZEW Mannheim and University of Mannheim
series.notes: Competition economics and competition law; conference page URL pattern www.zew.de/MacciAnnual<year>

series.name: Jornadas de Economia Industrial (JEI)
series.organizer: Industrial Economics Committee of the Spanish Economic Association (AEE)
series.notes: Host university rotates within Spain; papers in English

series.name: CEPR-JIE Conference on Applied Industrial Organization
series.organizer: CEPR and the Journal of Industrial Economics (JIE)
series.notes: Host city rotates within Europe; submissions via CEPR HUB; no registration fee

series.name: ZEW Conference on the Economics of Information and Communication Technologies
series.organizer: ZEW - Leibniz Centre for European Economic Research
series.notes: Heinz Koenig Young Scholar Award (EUR 5,000) for best paper by an author under 35

series.name: Paris Conference on Digital Economics
series.organizer: Innovation & Regulation Chair, Institut Polytechnique de Paris (Telecom Paris)
series.notes: Full papers required; conference page URL pattern /conference-<year>

series.name: TSE Digital Economics Conference
series.organizer: TSE Digital Center, Toulouse School of Economics, with CEPR
series.site_note: Each edition gets a new page on tse-fr.eu (e.g. /conferences/2027-19th-digital-economics-conference)
series.notes: In person only; abstracts considered but papers preferred

series.name: CCP Annual Conference
series.organizer: Centre for Competition Policy (CCP), University of East Anglia
series.notes: Policy-oriented; open call for contributions issued in 2025 but none found for 2026 - drop if no call appears

series.name: Workshop on UK Digital Economics
series.organizer: UK Researcher-Practitioner Network for the Economics of Digitization, with the Centre for Competition Policy (UEA)
series.site_note: Each edition is listed on the CCP events page; host venue varies (2026: Bennett School, Cambridge)
series.notes: One-day workshop; speakers exempt from fees

series.name: BECCLE Competition Policy Conference
series.organizer: Bergen Center for Competition Law and Economics (BECCLE): NHH and University of Bergen
series.notes: Competition law and economics; no conference fee (2026)

series.name: SIOE Annual Conference
series.organizer: Society for Institutional & Organizational Economics (SIOE)
series.notes: Venue rotates (2025 Sydney, 2026 Fontainebleau, 2027 Warwick). Individual papers and panels.

series.name: ITS Biennial Conference
series.organizer: International Telecommunications Society (ITS)
series.site_note: Each edition has its own site (e.g. https://its2026tokyo.org/)
series.notes: Venue rotates worldwide (2024 Seoul, 2026 Tokyo); in scope only when held in an in-scope region

series.name: ITS European Conference
series.organizer: International Telecommunications Society (ITS) - ITS Europe
series.notes: Telecom/digital economics and policy; regional conference in odd years (2023 Madrid, 2025 Edinburgh) plus smaller European events (2026 Madrid)

series.name: BSE Summer Forum: Applied Industrial Organization
series.organizer: Barcelona School of Economics (BSE) Summer Forum
series.notes: Deadline of past calls not visible after closing

series.name: BSE Summer Forum: Workshop on Relational Contracts
series.organizer: Barcelona School of Economics (BSE) Summer Forum
series.notes: Organizational economics; 12th edition in 2026

series.name: Organisational Economics Workshop (University of Sydney)
series.organizer: University of Sydney
series.site_note: No dedicated website found; the call is posted on Econometric Society Australasia regional news (search 'Organisational Economics Workshop Sydney 2027')
series.notes: No registration fee; extended abstracts accepted

series.name: Society of Labor Economists (SOLE) Annual Meeting
series.organizer: Society of Labor Economists (SOLE)
series.typical_deadline: End of October to 1 December (31 Oct 2026 for the 2027 meeting)
series.notes: Every fifth year the meeting is replaced by the joint SOLE-EALE-AASLE World Labor Conference (2025 Toronto; 2030 hosted by AASLE). One submission per person.

series.name: EALE Annual Conference
series.organizer: European Association of Labour Economists (EALE)
series.typical_conference: Late August to September (2027: 14-16 October, Munich)
series.notes: Each edition has its own host-university website linked from eale.nl. The EALE Tour (young scholars) is excluded.

series.name: ESPE Annual Conference
series.organizer: European Society for Population Economics (ESPE)
series.notes: Future hosts listed at https://www.espe.org/conferences (2027: Faculty of Economics, University of Zagreb).

series.name: Society of Economics of the Household (SEHO) Annual Meeting
series.organizer: Society of Economics of the Household (SEHO)
series.associated_journal: Review of Economics of the Household
series.notes: Rotates between US, Europe and Asia (2024 Singapore, 2025 Zaragoza, 2026 Pavia, 2027 Pittsburgh). Each meeting has its own host site linked from the society page. SEHO also organizes an ASSA session.

series.name: Human Capital Conference (TSE-CEPR)
series.organizer: TSE Human Capital Center with the support of CEPR
series.site_note: Each edition has its own TSE conference page and CEPR event page (1st edition: https://cepr.org/events/1st-human-capital-conference); search 'TSE Human Capital Conference 2027'.
series.notes: Started 2026 (Toulouse, 22-23 June). Next edition announced for 21-22 June 2027. No registration fee in 2026.

series.name: Workshop on Labour Economics (IAAEU, Trier)
series.organizer: IAAEU and Chair of Personnel Economics, Trier University
series.notes: Labour and personnel economics; PhD students encouraged. Edition page usually at http://www.iaaeu.de/WLE<year>.

series.name: CESifo Area Conference on Labor Economics
series.organizer: CESifo Research Network
series.notes: The 2024 call explicitly invited both CESifo network members and non-members. A paper may be submitted to only one CESifo Area Conference. The separate CESifo Junior Workshop on Labor Economics is excluded (junior).

series.name: IZA@LISER Conference in Labour Economics
series.organizer: IZA Network at LISER (Luxembourg Institute of Socio-Economic Research)
series.notes: Inaugural edition 10-11 Dec 2026; recurrence not yet confirmed. The Bonn-based IZA institute closed at the end of 2025 and the IZA Network moved to LISER from 1 Jan 2026; the former Bonn IZA workshops (World Labor Conference, labor market institutions, gender, matching, etc.) were not found active.

series.name: LERA Annual Meeting
series.organizer: Labor and Employment Relations Association (LERA)
series.typical_deadline: Mid-November (sessions, papers, posters); competitive papers mid-December
series.notes: Interdisciplinary (economics, industrial relations, HR, law). Abstract-based proposals.

series.name: LERA Sessions at the ASSA Annual Meeting
series.organizer: Labor and Employment Relations Association (LERA)
series.notes: Labor-specific call within ASSA; session proposals preferred; presenters must be LERA members.

series.name: Canadian Labour Economics Forum (CLEF) Conference
series.organizer: Canadian Labour Economics Forum (CLEF)
series.notes: Started 2025 (UBC Stone Centre). Old site clef.uwaterloo.ca now redirects to clef.uqam.ca. Includes a Best Paper Prize for students and recent PhDs.

series.name: Labour Econometrics Workshop (LEW)
series.organizer: Rotating Australian/New Zealand host university
series.site_note: Hosted by a different Australian/NZ university each year (2026: UWA Business School, Perth); announced on Econometric Society Australasia regional news; search 'Labour Econometrics Workshop 2027'.
series.notes: Full paper or extended abstract accepted (2026).

series.name: AASLE Annual Conference
series.organizer: Asian and Australasian Society of Labour Economics (AASLE)
series.notes: Rotates around Asia-Pacific. 2026 (Beijing) and 2027 (Ho Chi Minh City) editions are outside the dashboard regions, so no call files for them; past in-scope hosts include Tokyo 2022, Taipei 2023, Singapore 2019, Korea 2018, Australia 2017.

series.name: SOLE-EALE-AASLE World Labor Conference
series.organizer: SOLE, EALE and AASLE (host society rotates)
series.site_note: Posted on the host society's site (2025: SOLE, sole-jole.org; 2030: AASLE, aasle.org/conferences).
series.typical_deadline: 1 December of the preceding year (2025 edition)
series.notes: Sixth World Labor Conference: Toronto, 27-29 June 2025. 2030 edition hosted by AASLE; details to follow.

series.name: Urban Economics Association North American Meeting
series.organizer: Urban Economics Association (UEA)
series.notes: Venue alternates between US and Canadian hosts (Montreal 2025, Chicago 2026). Each edition has a call page at urbaneconomics.org/meetings/uea<year>/call.html; submissions via Editorial Express.

series.name: Urban Economics Association European Meeting
series.organizer: Urban Economics Association (UEA)
series.notes: Call page pattern: urbaneconomics.org/meetings/emuea<year>/call.html. 2027: Sciences Po and PSE, Paris, 27-28 May 2027. No separate UEA Asian meeting or UEA call for ASSA sessions was found.

series.name: AREUEA-ASSA Conference
series.organizer: American Real Estate and Urban Economics Association (AREUEA)
series.notes: AREUEA sessions held with the ASSA/AEA Annual Meeting. Submission link on the AREUEA member-content page. Separate student/post-doc poster call (Nov deadline) not tracked.

series.name: AREUEA National Conference
series.organizer: American Real Estate and Urban Economics Association (AREUEA)
series.notes: Standalone meeting in Washington, DC (Watergate Hotel in 2026 and 2027); distinct from the AREUEA-ASSA sessions in January.

series.name: AREUEA International Conference
series.organizer: American Real Estate and Urban Economics Association (AREUEA)
series.notes: Venue rotates worldwide (2024 Curacao and Hsinchu, Taiwan; 2025 Barcelona; 2026 Medellin, Colombia). Only editions in scope regions count.

series.name: European Regional Science Association (ERSA) Congress
series.organizer: European Regional Science Association (ERSA)
series.typical_deadline: Special sessions mid/late December; abstracts/papers late February
series.notes: Two-stage call: special-session proposals first, then the general call for abstracts/papers.

series.name: North American Meetings of the Regional Science Association International (NARSC)
series.organizer: North American Regional Science Council (NARSC)
series.notes: Future venues listed at https://www.narsc.org/newsite/conference/past-and-future-conferences/ (2027: New Orleans, 10-13 Nov).

series.name: IEB Workshop on Urban Economics
series.organizer: Institut d'Economia de Barcelona (IEB), University of Barcelona
series.notes: 7th edition 2024, 8th edition 17-18 June 2026; biennial pattern inferred (could not re-verify: IEB site returned HTTP 429). Papers by e-mail to ieb.workshop@ub.edu; no registration fee.

series.name: SMU-Jinan Conference on Urban and Regional Economics
series.organizer: Singapore Management University School of Economics and Jinan University
series.site_note: Annual conference alternating between SMU, Singapore (even years; page economics.smu.edu.sg/events/urban/<year>) and Jinan University, Guangzhou (odd years; out of scope). Biennial here counts only the Singapore editions.
series.notes: 2026 edition joint with the 11th World Bank-GWU Urbanization and Development Conference. Listed on the UEA related-meetings page.

series.name: ITEA Annual Conference on Transportation Economics (formerly Kuhmo Nectar)
series.organizer: International Transportation Economics Association (ITEA)
series.site_note: Each edition is hosted by a different university on its own site (itea2026.com; conferences.leeds.ac.uk/itea2024; transportation.northwestern.edu/news-events/itea2025). Search 'ITEA 2027 conference transportation economics'.

series.name: hEART Symposium of the European Association for Research in Transportation
series.organizer: European Association for Research in Transportation (hEART)
series.site_note: Association page lists each symposium (heart/<year>.php); the local organizer runs a separate site for the call.
series.notes: Broad transportation research (modelling, operations, economics). 2027: Jagiellonian University, Krakow.

series.name: Transportation Research Board (TRB) Annual Meeting
series.organizer: Transportation Research Board (TRB) of the National Academies
series.site_note: The call sits on a per-year National Academies event page (2027 meeting = event 887); find the new one via the TRB Annual Meeting page.
series.notes: Broad transportation research meeting, not only economics; full papers required.

series.name: World Conference on Transport Research (WCTR)
series.organizer: World Conference on Transport Research Society (WCTRS)
series.site_note: Each conference also has its own site (e.g. wctr2026.fr).
series.typical_deadline: October of the year before (full papers)
series.notes: Venue rotates worldwide (2019 Mumbai, 2023 Montreal, 2026 Toulouse); only in-scope editions count.

series.name: Thredbo International Conference Series on Competition and Ownership in Land Passenger Transport
series.organizer: Thredbo Conference Series
series.notes: Workshop-based conference; venue rotates worldwide (2026 Valletta, Malta). Only in-scope editions count.

series.name: Southern Regional Science Association (SRSA) Annual Meeting
series.organizer: Southern Regional Science Association (SRSA)
series.notes: Site still showed the 2026 meeting (65th, Louisville) on 2026-10-10; deadlines not verified.

series.name: AAEA Annual Meeting
series.organizer: Agricultural & Applied Economics Association (AAEA)
series.notes: Selected papers/posters and organized symposia have the same deadline; presenters must be AAEA members. The cfp_page path changes each year (/meetings/<year>-aaea-annual-meeting/).

series.name: EAAE Congress
series.organizer: European Association of Agricultural Economists (EAAE)
series.site_note: Each congress has its own website run by the host (2025: ilr1.uni-bonn.de/eaaecongress2025); eaae.org links to it.
series.typical_deadline: early in the congress year (not verified)
series.notes: 2027: Šibenik, Croatia (31 Aug-3 Sep). 2029: Uppsala, Sweden (19-22 Jun).

series.name: Economic History Association Annual Meeting
series.organizer: Economic History Association (EHA)
series.notes: 1,000-word proposal plus 150-word abstract; at least one author must be an EHA member.

series.name: EHES Conference
series.organizer: European Historical Economics Society (EHES)
series.notes: 2027: University of Antwerp, 10-11 Sep 2027; call to be published 1 Nov 2026.

series.name: Economic Science Association North American Meeting
series.organizer: Economic Science Association (ESA)
series.associated_journal: Experimental Economics; Journal of the Economic Science Association
series.notes: Host rotates among North American universities. Each meeting has an ESA event page (members.economicscience.org) plus a local conference site.

series.name: Economic Science Association European Meeting
series.organizer: Economic Science Association (ESA)
series.associated_journal: Experimental Economics; Journal of the Economic Science Association
series.notes: Host rotates among European universities (2026 Universitat Pompeu Fabra, Barcelona).

series.name: Economic Science Association World Meeting
series.organizer: Economic Science Association (ESA)
series.associated_journal: Experimental Economics; Journal of the Economic Science Association
series.notes: Venue moves between continents (2023 Lyon, 2026 Marina del Rey). No 2027 World Meeting listed as of 2026-10-11; only in-scope editions should be recorded.

series.name: SAET Annual Conference
series.organizer: Society for the Advancement of Economic Theory (SAET)
series.notes: Venue rotates worldwide (2025 Ischia, 2026 Rio de Janeiro, 2027 Faro). Program built largely from organized sessions; attendees pay SAET membership dues in addition to registration.

series.name: Midwest Economic Theory and International Trade Conference (Midwest Theory meetings)
series.organizer: Midwest Economic Theory and International Trade Conference (rotating university hosts)
series.notes: Theory and trade programs run side by side; submissions via Editorial Express; no registration or submission fee (Fall 2026). Future hosts: Spring 2027 Colorado Boulder, Fall 2027 Drexel, Spring 2028 Indiana, Fall 2028 NC State.

series.name: Midwest Finance Association (MFA) Annual Meeting
series.organizer: Midwest Finance Association (MFA)

series.name: European Financial Management Association (EFMA) Annual Meeting
series.organizer: European Financial Management Association (EFMA)

series.name: Public Choice Society Annual Meetings
series.organizer: Public Choice Society
series.notes: Proposals need only a title and abstract; presenters upload the full paper before the meeting.

series.name: Annual Meeting of the European Public Choice Society (EPCS)
series.organizer: European Public Choice Society (EPCS)
series.notes: Each meeting has its own host website (e.g. epcsmadrid2026.es). The society site fails some automated TLS checks.

series.name: ASHEcon Annual Conference
series.organizer: American Society of Health Economists (ASHEcon)
series.notes: Submissions via Confex (ashecon.confex.com). ASHEcon also organizes sessions at ASSA with IHEA and HERO (separate call, deadline around late April).

series.name: EuHEA Conference
series.organizer: European Health Economics Association (EuHEA)
series.notes: Biennial main conference in even years (2026 Rotterdam). The separate EuHEA PhD & Supervisor Conference is a PhD event and out of scope.

series.name: Essen Health Conference
series.organizer: University of Duisburg-Essen (Chair of Health Economics) and CINCH - Competent in Competition and Health
series.notes: Health, education and labour economics and their intersections; no registration fee.

series.name: European Workshop on Econometrics and Health Economics
series.organizer: Andrew Jones (University of York) and Owen O'Donnell (Erasmus University Rotterdam) with a rotating local host
series.notes: Small workshop (about 40 participants); papers selected on full drafts. Calls are also posted on the local host's site.

series.name: Health Economics Conference (TSE-CEPR)
series.organizer: CEPR and TSE Health Center, Toulouse School of Economics
series.notes: Focus on innovation, pharmaceutical markets and regulation. Each edition has its own page on tse-fr.eu; cepr.org event pages may block automated access.

series.name: IIPF Annual Congress
series.organizer: International Institute of Public Finance (IIPF)
series.notes: Venue rotates worldwide; only in-scope editions should be listed (2027: Warsaw). Completed papers only; EUR 20 submission fee for non-members; presenters must become IIPF members.

series.name: NTA Annual Conference on Taxation
series.organizer: National Tax Association (NTA)
series.notes: Abstract submissions (papers, sessions, panels) via All Academic; NTA membership not required. The NTA Spring Symposium has no open call and is not tracked.

series.name: Society for Economic Dynamics (SED) Annual Meeting
series.organizer: Society for Economic Dynamics (SED)
series.notes: Venue rotates (2025 Copenhagen, 2026 Athens, 2027 Lisbon); submissions via Conference Maker.

series.name: International Conference on Computing in Economics and Finance (CEF)
series.organizer: Society for Computational Economics (SCE)
series.notes: Usually alternates between North America and Europe; 2025 was held in Santiago, Chile (out of scope). comp-econ.org redirects to comp-econ.com.

series.name: Midwest Macroeconomics Meetings
series.organizer: Midwest Macroeconomics Group (rotating US host)
series.site_note: Group page (Purdue) lists hosts and links to each Conference Maker page; each meeting also has a host-university page.
series.typical_deadline: About two months before each meeting
series.notes: Call files use ids midwest-macro-<year>-spring / -fall.

series.name: Annual Symposium of the Society for Nonlinear Dynamics and Econometrics (SNDE)
series.organizer: Society for Nonlinear Dynamics and Econometrics (SNDE)
series.notes: 2025 San Antonio, 2026 Catolica Lisbon, 2027 Pomona College. Old site sndeecon.org has a certificate error / 404.

series.name: IAAE Annual Conference
series.organizer: International Association for Applied Econometrics (IAAE)
series.site_note: Each edition has its own site (2025: sites.google.com/view/iaae2025; 2026: iaae2026.pages.dev, Nova SBE). Note: iaae.org is an unrelated airport association. Search "IAAE 2027 annual conference applied econometrics".
series.notes: Recent hosts: 2024 Xiamen (out of scope), 2025 Torino, 2026 Carcavelos.

series.name: (EC)^2 Conference (European Conferences of the Econometrics Community)
series.organizer: (EC)^2 steering committee with a rotating European host
series.site_note: Each edition is posted by the host (2026: econ.au.dk/ace/activities/ec2). Search "(EC)2 conference 2027".
series.notes: Each edition has a theme; small (fewer than 100 participants).

series.name: Midwest Econometrics Group (MEG) Annual Meeting
series.organizer: Midwest Econometrics Group (rotating US host)
series.site_note: Hosted by a different university each year (2026: University of Cincinnati, business.uc.edu/.../meg-2026.html). Search "Midwest Econometrics Group 2027".
series.notes: Accepts extended abstracts, full papers or sessions via Conference Maker.

series.name: International Symposium on Forecasting (ISF)
series.organizer: International Institute of Forecasters (IIF)
series.notes: forecasters.org returns HTTP 403 to automated fetches. Rotates worldwide; record only in-scope venues.

series.name: CFE-CMStatistics Conference
series.organizer: CFEnetwork and CMStatistics
series.notes: Hybrid format.

series.name: International Panel Data Conference (IPDC)
series.organizer: Rotating host university
series.site_note: Each edition has its own site (2026: sites.exeter.ac.uk/ipdc2026; 2027: ipdc2027.unican.es). Search "International Panel Data Conference 2028".

series.name: SoFiE Annual Conference
series.organizer: Society for Financial Econometrics (SoFiE)
series.notes: Rotating worldwide (2024 Rio, 2025 Cergy, 2026 Macau); record only in-scope venues. Stern SoFiE pages now redirect to tilburguniversity.edu (403 to automated tools).

series.name: Canadian Econometrics Study Group (CESG) Annual Meeting
series.organizer: Canadian Econometrics Study Group (rotating Canadian host)
series.notes: Completed papers only. https://www.caneconometrics.ca does not resolve; use http://caneconometrics.ca.

series.name: AE2 Conference of the Australian and New Zealand Association of Econometricians (ANZAE)
series.organizer: Australian and New Zealand Association of Econometricians (ANZAE / AE2)
series.site_note: nzesg.auckland.ac.nz points to the ANZAE (AE2) site; each conference is posted by its host university (2026: sydney.edu.au).
series.notes: Successor since 2025 of the New Zealand Econometric Study Group / Australia New Zealand Econometric Study Group (NZESG/ANZESG), whose last meeting was February 2025 in Wellington.

series.name: International Symposium on Econometric Theory and Applications (SETA)
series.organizer: SETA Advisory Committee with a rotating Asia-Pacific host
series.site_note: Each symposium is posted by its host (2025: University of Macau; 2027: fbe.unimelb.edu.au). Search "SETA 2028 econometric theory".
series.notes: Rotates across Asia and Australasia; many editions are in mainland China/Macau (out of scope).

series.name: Lancaster SoFiE Financial Econometrics Conference (FINEC)
series.organizer: Lancaster University Management School, sponsored by SoFiE
series.site_note: Each edition has its own site (wp.lancs.ac.uk/finec<year>/).
series.notes: Frequency not verified; GBP 30 submission fee in 2027.

series.name: Vienna Workshop on High-Dimensional Time Series in Macroeconomics and Finance
series.organizer: Institute for Advanced Studies (IHS), Vienna

series.name: European Trade Study Group (ETSG) Annual Conference
series.organizer: European Trade Study Group (ETSG)
series.notes: Host rotates across Europe (Exeter 2026, Toledo 2027); one paper per participant; Review of World Economics prize for young economists

series.name: Midwest International Trade & Theory Conference (Midwest Economic Theory and International Trade Meetings)
series.organizer: Midwest International Economics Group and Midwest Economic Theory group (rotating host universities)
series.notes: Separate trade and theory submission tracks (Editorial Express). No registration or submission fee. Announced hosts: Spring 2027 U of Colorado Boulder (16-18 Apr), Fall 2027 Drexel, Spring 2028 Indiana, Fall 2028 NC State.

series.name: BSE Summer Forum: Geography, Trade and Growth
series.organizer: Barcelona School of Economics (BSE) Summer Forum / CREI
series.notes: Run under the same title 2017-2026; no registration fee.

series.name: Northeast Universities Development Consortium Conference (NEUDC)
series.organizer: Northeast Universities Development Consortium (rotating host universities)
series.notes: Each edition has its own host site linked from neudc.org (Cornell 2026, Brown 2027). Full drafts only.

series.name: CSAE Conference: Economic Development in Africa
series.organizer: Centre for the Study of African Economies (CSAE), University of Oxford
series.notes: Full drafts only; one paper per author; limited funding for Africa-based presenters.
